annotation.title_clean: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
annotation.title_en: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
named_instruments_referenced: PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts in the PDPA
IMDA Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI
annotation.summary_en: Singapore PDPC advisory guidelines explaining how the PDPA applies to generative AI: web-scraped training data and the Publicly Available Exception, consent and AI-specific notification for user data, roles of model providers, system providers and deployers, and handling of access and correction requests. Non-binding; no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publicly Available Exception may cover scraped data, including some behind digital barriers, subject to documented assessment such as a DPIA.
General notifications are insufficient for large-scale GenAI training on user data; AI-specific notifications are required.
Model providers, system providers and deployers may be organisations or data intermediaries with Protection and Retention Limitation duties.
Deployers bear primary responsibility for PDPA compliance and should safeguard agentic AI deployments.
Access and correction obligations apply to GenAI data, with best practices such as provenance records and output filters.
